LanguageData.DC_Patch161LetterText:
Perk trees no longer use points. Colonists unlock a perk automatically at skill 5, 10, 15, and 20. If a skill falls below that level, the perk lapses.

Shooting accuracy bonuses now use the same scale as vanilla traits — they used to round to +0.0 on inspect. Perk effects stay off the Health tab unless you enable "Show perk hediffs" in mod settings. Skill-20 capstones are on by default.

The Family tree button on the Bio card is gone so it no longer covers Banish — use the Family inspect tab. Rows / Pedigree sits left of the close button.

Opening a Strata floor no longer throws while last-of-the-line scans living colonists.

Open perk trees from a colonist's inspect pane or the Perks colony tab.

LanguageData.DC_Settings_EnableFamilyJoinTip: Family of colonists may join from visits, or defect from raids. Spouse is the highest chance. Ex-lovers never join this way (0%). Non-hostile family recruit skips the goodwill penalty; hostile kin keep a faction grudge. Unwavering prisoners can be reached by family they like (both ways). Also: in-law welcome, kin homecoming, kin dying or executed, breakup wounds, grandchild born, kin taken, tended by family, last of the line, step-family, prison visits, releasing kin, family-tradition teaching, kin downed in a fight, and empty nest.
